# Country scope. True for a sovereign great power, empire, or player realm eligible for Definitive milestones.
oe_def_is_chronicle_great_power = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		is_great_power = yes
		country_rank = country_rank:rank_empire
		num_locations >= 40
	}
}

# Country scope. True for a consolidated independent realm ready for Grand Chancery & Protocol reforms.
oe_def_is_chancery_ready_realm = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no

	OR = {
		is_ai = no
		is_great_power = yes
		num_locations >= 25
	}
}

# Country scope. True for a major sovereign entering the Age of Discovery or later.
oe_def_is_third_era_sovereign = {
	is_rebel_country = no
